title: snp_demux: a Snakemake workflow for SNP-based single-cell demultiplexing
description: A Snakemake workflow that demultiplexes genetically-pooled single-cell RNA-seq captures back to their donors from natural genetic variation. It runs vireo, demuxlet, freemuxlet and souporcell and combines them into a Demuxafy consensus per-cell assignment, with HTML QC reports. The expensive per-cell pileups are produced upstream by sc_pileup and consumed here, so the fast assignment step can be re-run and re-tuned cheaply. It runs standalone or as a git submodule within a DVC-tracked dataset.
